description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific Stripe invoice payment by ID. Use when you need to get information about an existing invoice payment.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for retrieving an invoice payment.

id.description: The unique identifier for the invoice payment to retrieve. This ID typically starts with 'inpay_'.
id.title: Id

inputSchema.title: GetInvoicePaymentsIdRequest

name: get_invoice_payments_id

GetInvoicePaymentsIdResponse.description: Response containing detailed information about the invoice payment.

amount_paid.description: Sum actually paid in the smallest currency unit (e.g., cents for USD). Remains null until status becomes 'paid'. May be less than amount_requested.
amount_paid.title: Amount Paid

amount_requested.description: Amount intended to be paid toward this invoice in the smallest currency unit (e.g., cents for USD).
amount_requested.title: Amount Requested

created.description: Unix timestamp indicating when the object was created.
created.title: Created

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code in lowercase (e.g., 'usd').
currency.title: Currency

id.description: Unique identifier for the invoice payment object.
id.title: Id

invoice.description: Reference to the associated invoice identifier.
invoice.title: Invoice

is_default.description: Indicates if auto-created by system when invoice finalizes. Default payment cannot be directly modified.
is_default.title: Is Default

livemode.description: Has the value true if the object exists in live mode or the value false if the object exists in test mode.
livemode.title: Livemode

object.description: String representing the object's type. Value is 'invoice_payment'.
object.title: Object

payment.description: Payment details container with information about the payment method used.
payment.title: Payment

status.description: Current status of the invoice payment. Possible values: 'open', 'paid', 'canceled'.
status.title: Status

status_transitions.description: Timestamp records for status changes (canceled_at, paid_at).
status_transitions.title: Status Transitions

GetInvoicePaymentsIdResponse.title: GetInvoicePaymentsIdResponse

Payment.description: Payment details for the invoice payment.

charge.description: Charge ID when type is 'charge' (only if not linked to PaymentIntent).
charge.title: Charge

payment_intent.description: PaymentIntent ID when type is 'payment_intent'. Populated for invoices finalized after March 15, 2019.
payment_intent.title: Payment Intent

type.description: Type of payment. One of: 'charge', 'payment_intent', or 'payment_record'.
type.title: Type

Payment.title: Payment

PaymentType.description: Payment type enum for invoice payments.
PaymentType.title: PaymentType

canceled_at.description: Unix timestamp indicating when the payment was canceled.
canceled_at.title: Canceled At

paid_at.description: Unix timestamp indicating when the payment succeeded.
paid_at.title: Paid At
